# The expected scorecard of the software factory acceptance scenario
# (crates/ua-server/tests/factory_scenario.rs; docs/software-factory-status.md).
#
# One line per check: <step> <check-id> <status>, status one of pass, fail,
# not-built. The test fails when its scorecard differs from this file in any
# line. This file is the truth about what works at this commit, and it only
# moves forward: change a line from not-built or fail to pass in the same
# change that makes the check pass. Never move a line away from pass.
